questions2.question2: When and where do you usually have meals?

questions2_answer.question2: I usually have breakfast at home around 7 AM, lunch at work or school around noon, and dinner at home around 7 PM. I prefer eating with family.

questions3.question3_1: Tell me the last time you had a good meal?
questions3.question3_2: I want to visit your country? Do you have any suggestions for me on what delicious food to eat?
questions3.question3_3: 3.	Today, many people eat pizza. But it is not healthy and they should limit eating it. What is your opinion?

questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: The last time I had a great meal was at a family gathering last weekend. We had grilled fish, fried rice, and a delicious dessert. Everything was so tasty and satisfying.
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: If you visit my country, I highly recommend trying pho, banh mi, and fresh spring rolls. These dishes are famous for their unique flavors and are a must-try when you're here.
questions3_answer.question3_3_answer: I agree that pizza is delicious but not very healthy. It’s high in fat and calories, so it should be eaten in moderation. It’s fine as an occasional treat but not a regular meal.

questions4_main: Dear members, the club needs volunteers to be guest speakers for the talk show with a famous chef. Please suggest your desire to be a speaker and what topic will you talk about?
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words). Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why?
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words). Tell the manager what suggestions you will make and why?
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I just heard that the club needs volunteers to be guest speakers for the talk show with the famous chef. I plan to suggest talking about healthy cooking tips. What do you think?
Let me know soon!
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am writing to express my strong interest in volunteering as a guest speaker for the upcoming talk show featuring the acclaimed chef. I am particularly excited about this opportunity, which I believe offers a fantastic chance to engage our members.
I would like to propose two specific topics for discussion. Firstly, I am keen to discuss effective healthy cooking techniques. This subject, I am confident, would greatly benefit many club members by enabling them to make more informed dietary choices.
Secondly, I would address practical methods for preparing simple yet nutritious meals at home. This would undoubtedly inspire attendees to adopt a more health-conscious approach to their daily cooking, thereby promoting overall well-being.
I am truly passionate about these areas and would be delighted to share accessible recipes and valuable tips. Please inform me if my participation would be welcome.
Best regards,
Phuong
